data.name: UnderRed
data.detailed_description:
Team-Based Competitive Gameplay

  • 5v5 Team Deathmatch — Coordinate with your squad, call out enemy positions, and execute strategies to dominate the arena.
  • Free-for-All Mode — Every player for themselves in chaotic 8-player deathmatches.
  • Tactical Minimap — Real-time enemy positions help you plan flanks and coordinate team pushes.
  • Live Scoreboard — Track kills, deaths, and team performance in real-time.

Esports-Ready Design

  • Skill-Based Combat — No RNG, no luck. Pure aim and strategy determine the winner.
  • Spectator Mode — Watch matches as a ghost, fly through walls, and observe from any angle.
  • Steam Leaderboards — Compete for the top spot and prove your dominance.

Intense Close-Quarters FPS Combat

UnderRed drops you into tight, unforgiving arenas where every corner could be your last. Master a deadly arsenal of weapons — from rapid-fire automatics to precision semi-automatics, devastating shotguns, and explosive grenades — each with its own zoom, recoil, and handling characteristics. Toggle iron sights for precise aiming, switch between hip-fire and zoom on the fly, and learn the unique feel of every gun in your loadout.

Play Solo or With Friends

  • Solo Mode with AI Enemies — Face off against aggressive AI soldiers that hunt you down, dodge obstacles, and close in for brutal point-blank engagements. Perfect for solo practice or a quick adrenaline rush.
  • Team Deathmatch — Join forces with your teammates in intense 5v5 battles. Communication and coordination are key to victory.
  • Multiplayer via Steam — Host or join online lobbies for up to 8 players in team-based or free-for-all deathmatches. Powered by Steam's peer-to-peer networking with seamless hot-join support — jump into the action at any time without waiting for a new round.
  • Spectator Mode — Observe ongoing matches as a ghost. Fly freely through the map, clip through walls, and watch the chaos unfold from any angle.

Tactical Gameplay Features

  • Multiple Weapons — Switch between distinct weapons, each with unique zoom levels, recoil patterns, and fire rates.
  • Minimap — A top-down tactical minimap shows your surroundings, highlights enemy positions, and keeps you oriented in the heat of battle.
  • Live Scoreboard — Hold TAB to see real-time kills, deaths, and rankings for every player in the match.
  • Customizable Settings — Adjust crosshair size, mouse sensitivity, and other settings to match your playstyle.

Aggressive AI That Fights Back

Enemy soldiers don't just stand around waiting to be shot. They detect you from across the arena, dodge around obstacles using predictive steering, and charge in for relentless close-range combat. With multiple soldier variants and dynamic pathfinding, no two encounters play out the same way.

Seamless Steam Integration

Built from the ground up with Steamworks, UnderRed features integrated lobby browsing, Steam friend invitations, and reliable P2P networking. Your kills and stats are tracked throughout each session on the live scoreboard.

data.short_description: UnderRed is a fast-paced team-based FPS featuring intense 5v5 combat and free-for-all modes for up to 8 players. Coordinate with your team, master diverse weapons, and dominate the arena. Free to Play.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent gun violence with realistic blood effects. Players shoot and kill each other or AI opponents using pistols, rifles, and sniper rifles in competitive free-for-all combat. There is no story-driven violence, sexual content, drug use, or strong language.
